usefulness.rationale: The dossier body is empty; only the identity anchors supply information (Barbadian politician and lawyer, MP for Saint Michael North East, prime minister from 2018). A reader learns only the most basic identity, with no detail on accomplishments, policy, or career history, and there is no dossier text claiming completeness — remainingQuestions is best treated as maximal clarity-by-absence, though this is somewhat ambiguous since an empty dossier implicitly implies nothing. Conversation readiness is minimal: only enough to greet and address her correctly, not to prepare substantive talking points. No overclaims exist because there are no dossier claims or citations to evaluate; the two listed unjustified conclusions concern claims that do not appear in any dossier statement, so they cannot be matched.
